# OnDevice

> OnDevice makes free, open-source iPhone apps that run AI models entirely on the device: chat with local LLMs, camera vision, voice, image generation, and an OpenAI-compatible local API. No account, no telemetry, no cloud inference by default. App Store releases are coming soon. Public sideload downloads have been retired; official App Store links will be added when available.

Website: https://ondevice.fun/ (English), https://ondevice.fun/tr/ (Turkish), https://ondevice.fun/zh/ (Simplified Chinese)
Source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ondevice-core
License: MIT for original code; model weights keep their own licences and are downloaded separately.

## Apps

- OnDevice Max — status: App Store coming soon, 1.0.0 (75). iOS 27. The newest all-in-one studio with a new interface: chat, camera Lens (ask, translate, scan, solve), voice conversations, image studio, model library, device status, local API server, paired-Mac tools.
- OnDevice Core — status: App Store coming soon, 1.0.0 (65). iOS 27. Same on-device engine and features as Max with the original Studio interface. Apple Core AI, MLX, llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, experimental Edge0 mixture-of-experts runtime.
- OnDevice LAS (On Device: LAS) — status: App Store coming soon, 3.2.6 (146). iOS 18. Local API server: OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Ollama-compatible routes on one port behind a bearer key.
- OnDevice Image Generation (app name "iOS Image Generation") — status: App Store coming soon, 1.0 (16) in testing. iOS / iPadOS 26. Stable Diffusion 1.5, 2.1, SDXL, SDXL Turbo and compatible fine-tunes (e.g. RealVisXL, Animagine XL) with MLX and Core ML; image-to-image, model catalog with device-fit checks, private gallery.

## Choosing

- iOS 27 and want the newest interface: OnDevice Max.
- iOS 27 and prefer the original Studio interface: OnDevice Core.
- Need an API for Cursor, scripts or agents: OnDevice LAS (iOS 18+), or the API server inside Max/Core.
- Want to make pictures: OnDevice Image Generation (iOS 26+).

## Availability

App Store releases are coming soon. Public IPA downloads and sideload installation instructions have been retired. Official App Store links will be published at https://ondevice.fun/ when available.

## Local API (LAS, and the API server in Max/Core)

- OpenAI: GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses (streaming supported)
- Anthropic: POST /v1/messages
- Ollama: model, chat and generate routes under /api
- Default port 11434. Header: Authorization: Bearer <key shown in the app>.
- Plain HTTP for a trusted local network only; do not port-forward. The listener stops when iOS backgrounds the app.

Example:

    curl -N http://PHONE-IP:11434/v1/chat/completions \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
      -d '{"model":"MODEL-ID","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'

## Model families referenced by the apps

Qwen 3, Qwen 3.5, Qwen2.5-Coder, Llama 3.2, Gemma 3, Phi-4, Mistral, Granite, LFM2.5, SmolLM, Edge0 MoE, SmolVLM2, FastVLM, Whisper, Kokoro, Stable Diffusion 1.5 / 2.1, SDXL, SDXL Turbo, RealVisXL, Animagine XL. Availability of a given model depends on device memory.

## Privacy boundaries

- Inference runs on the device. No account, analytics SDK or telemetry.
- Network use: model downloads you start, and optional features you enable (web access, Apple Private Cloud Compute in Max, paired Mac).
- If a model does not fit in memory the app says so; it never silently falls back to a cloud endpoint.
